Nebula v2 runs Super Mario Galaxy as native code built from SMGCommunity's Petari decompilation, on Windows, Linux, macOS and Android. You need your own copy of the game.

## Downloads

| System | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (x64) | [Nebula-Setup.exe](https://github.com/keepvaibin/nebula/releases/download/v2.0.0/Nebula-Setup.exe) |
| Linux (x86-64) | [Nebula-Linux-x64.tar.gz](https://github.com/keepvaibin/nebula/releases/download/v2.0.0/Nebula-Linux-x64.tar.gz) |
| macOS 12 or later (Apple silicon) | [Nebula-macOS.zip](https://github.com/keepvaibin/nebula/releases/download/v2.0.0/Nebula-macOS.zip) |
| Android 12 or later (64-bit ARM) | [Nebula-Android.apk](https://github.com/keepvaibin/nebula/releases/download/v2.0.0/Nebula-Android.apk) |

`SHA256SUMS` lists the SHA-256 of each download. The `.sig` and `.manifest` files are what Nebula's updates check before they install a new version.

## Install

**Windows:** run `Nebula-Setup.exe`. Setup asks for your disc image and installs Nebula for your account.

**Linux:** unpack the archive, then run `./install.sh` in its folder. It asks for your disc image, then whether to install for your account or as a portable folder.

**macOS:** unzip the download and move `Nebula.app` to Applications. Nebula is not signed by Apple: the first time, open it from **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway**. The included `How to open Nebula.txt` has the steps.

**Android:** install `Nebula-Android.apk`, open it, and choose your disc image.

Nebula reads Super Mario Galaxy for Wii from North America (RMGE01), Europe (RMGP01) or Japan (RMGJ01), as an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder.

## What's new

- Native code on Windows (Direct3D 12, Direct3D 11 or Vulkan), Linux and Android (Vulkan), and macOS (Metal).
- A home screen with Play, Settings, Benchmark and Quit, and updates from within the game.
- Upscaling, anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion, enhanced lighting and HDR options.
- Frame interpolation above 60 Hz.
- PlayStation, Steam, Steam Deck and other controllers, with gyro pointing on controllers that have motion sensors. Co-Star mode with a second controller.
- Cutscene skip with a confirmation, and dialogue speed up to Instant.
- Separate volumes for music, effects, voices, ambience, cutscenes and the Wii Remote speaker.
- Mods as `.luma` files, made with [LumaLink](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink). LumaKit comes installed. Riivolution packs and Dolphin texture packs can be imported directly.
- Save import and export in the game, from a Wii, Dolphin or the Switch release.
- Mii import for file icons.
- 34 achievements and play statistics, shown by a Luma in the Comet Observatory after the first Grand Star.
- Discord status with your current galaxy and mission (Windows, Linux and macOS).
- Menus in all 14 of the game's languages, and error codes with a saved report.

## Requirements

- **Windows:** Windows 10 (1803 or later) or Windows 11, 64-bit, with a GPU that supports Direct3D 11 or later.
- **Linux:** x86-64 with glibc 2.39 or later (for example Ubuntu 24.04 or Fedora 40), and a Vulkan 1.1 GPU driver.
- **macOS:** macOS 12 or later on Apple silicon.
- **Android:** Android 12 or later, 64-bit ARM, Vulkan 1.1.

## Known issues

- Heavy background CPU load can make the audio skip.
- HD replacement movies at 4K need hardware video decoding.

Report problems on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/keepvaibin/nebula/issues).
